title: Preservation of primariness under $\ell_1$-, $c_0$-, and $\ell_\infty$-sums of Banach spaces
summary: We prove transfer principles for the uniform primary factorisation property (UPFP) from a Banach space $X$ to the vector-valued sequence spaces $\ell_1(X)$, $c_0(X)$ and $\ell_\infty(X)$. The hypotheses are either finite-cotype assumptions on $X$ or $X^*$, or natural self-similarity assumptions on $X$. Consequently, under these conditions, the resulting vector-valued sequence spaces are primary.
